verdict.rationale: Vue's docs say it builds on standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Community users back this up: they report learning the basics in minutes or hours, a gentle learning curve, cleanly separated HTML, JS and styles within one component, and drop-in use via a script tag. Caveats come from users who note that the template syntax is its own DSL and that Vue does not use web standards like custom elements, so some new concepts remain. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation on how component syntax maps to standard HTML, CSS and JS, and evidence on how many Vue-specific concepts (directives, template DSL) must be learned.
